_comment: Grade 2 Unit 2 (What happens if we waste things?) is the only Stage 2 unit that can naturally carry Solving problems (2As, 'Suggest a personal action that could make a positive difference to an issue affecting self') — Stage 2 is otherwise at 17/18 coverage. Added 2026-09-17 to close the documented gap, in Bilal's own voice, matching the unit's existing beach-litter theme.

addExplainers.title: One thing I will do
addExplainers.body:
Bilal thought about the litter at the beach in Berbera, and he decided on one thing he could do himself: use a bottle he can fill up again and again, instead of buying a new plastic bottle every time.

Now it is your turn. Think about your own day — your lunch box, your school bag, your snacks. What is one thing YOU could do to make less waste?

Say it out loud: 'I will ...' Then tell your grown-up why it would help.
bullets: Think about the waste you make in your own day.
Choose one thing you could do differently.
Say: 'I will ...' and explain why it would help.

addObjectives.evidence: the Activity Sheet's new 'One thing I will do' page: "What is one thing YOU could do to make less waste? ... 'I will ...'" — suggests a personal action that could make a positive difference to an issue affecting the learner
